## Selected research

<p class="paper-kicker">Conditionally accepted · 2026</p>

### Unconventional Monetary Policy: Lessons from 2020–2024

With Silvana Tenreyro. *Journal of Economic Literature.*

This paper synthesises the literature on forward guidance and large-scale
asset purchases through the 2020–2024 episode, with a focus on policy design
and the commitment–flexibility trade-off.
:::

::: {.research-preview}
<p class="paper-kicker">Work in progress</p>

### Endogenous Growth in Multi-Sector Economies

This paper studies how sectoral heterogeneity shapes the medium-run effects of
aggregate demand shocks when productivity growth is endogenous.
:::
